Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1894/22 – FRIDAY, DECEMBER 26, 2014
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/UNU/4/6/LA/61/2011.
Land and Land Development Ministry Reference No.:
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotment of land called “Aththanak Gedara Watta” in total extent of about 0.0023 Hectares, depicted as Lot No. 1 in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 6381 dated 12.11.2014, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Nikahetiya in Medapalatha Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Udunuwara in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:
Lot No. 1 — Name of the Land: Aththanak Gedara Watta; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.
Boundaries:

North: Aththanak Gedara Watta claimed by H. M. L. K. Herath and steps; East: Steps and Aththanak Gedara Watta claimed by H. M. L. K. Herath; South: Aththanak Gedara Watta claimed by H. M. L. K. Herath; West: Aththanak Gedara Watta claimed by H. M. L. K. Herath.
Names and Address of the Claimants: 1. Mr. H. M. L. K. Herath, No. 31/B/1, Nikahetiya, Wattappola.
All persons interested in the aforesaid Land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear

personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Udunuwara on the 25th day of February, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of February, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
G. K. G. A. R. P. K. NANDANA, Divisional Secretary, Udunuwara. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Udunuwara, 22nd December, 2014. 01 - 331

CHAMPIKA NEROSH DHARMAPALA, Divisional Secretary, Balangoda. Divisional Secretariat, Balangoda, 23rd December, 2014.

—————————— LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: HP/De/2/L.A./ 88, KDS/HAR/4/2/1/34. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/9/2012/WS/363. I, hereby give notice Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1968, that the

Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for the construction of Medawala New Service Reservoir and Entrance Road under Grater Kandy and Suburban Water Supply Project step 1 of state - iii. Description of the Land to be acquired: Three allotments of lands in extent about 0.1017 Hectare, depicted in preliminary plan No. P.P.Maha/6379, surveyed and prepared by the superintend of surveyor, Kandy District, situated in the village of Medawala in Minor Division of Medasiya Pathtuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Harispathtuwa in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows: 01. Lot No. 01
Name of Land: Nagawala Hena; Claimed by: Mrs. Basnayaka Mudiyanselage Bandaramenike, No. 221/D, Nearby Medawela Primary Collage, Medawala, Harispathtuwa; Extent: 0.0046 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02
Name of Land: Galwete Hena; Claimed by: Mr. Herath Mudiyanselage Heenbanda, No. 221/1, Henegama Palkubura, Medawala, Harispathtuwa; Extent: 0.0078 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 03

Name of Land: Galwete Hena; Claimed by: Mr. Herath Mudiyanselage Somarathnabanda, No. 245, Henegama Palkubura, Medawala, Harispathtuwa; Extent: 0.0893 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid Land/Lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Harispathtuwa Divisional Secretary’s Office on the 11th day of February, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 04th day of February, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. M. P. S. B. RATHNAYAKA, Divisional Secretary, Harispathtuwa Division.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Nugawela, Harispathtuwa, 22nd December, 2014.
